sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last ten matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once this season, making this a favorable fixture for the league leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in what could be a crucial result in the title race, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a match between third and fifth place, while Wolverhampton Casuals—fourth and in strong recent form with three consecutive wins—welcome Wednesfield Community to what should be a competitive encounter. Bilston Town (6th) face Foley Meir (13th) at home, and Barnton host Shawbury United; Shawbury are in severe form trouble with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town travel to third-placed AFC Bridgnorth on the same afternoon, while New Mills visit bottom side Alsager Town and Brereton Social host Widnes Town (second-bottom with just 2 points). Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a clash between two struggling sides near the bottom of the table. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a mid-table encounter. A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social travel to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
